item.title: Funeral arrangements announced for former St. George Fire Chief Chuckie Albert

item.title: St. Vincent de Paul, Salvation Army prepping for cold weather
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Both St. Vincent de Paul and The Salvation Army will be available to increase bed space as freezing temperatures roll into Baton Rouge.&nbsp;The East Baton Rouge Mayor-President's office said that, along with the shelters, libraries and community centers will be open as warming centers.&nbsp;WBRZ Storm Station Meteorologist Malcolm Byron says it will dip below freezing around midnight, then drop into the mid-20s until sunrise. item.title: Christmas Alive brings live Nativity, holiday cheer to Denham Springs
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS -&nbsp;Livingston Parish's Students Against Destructive Decisions hosted its Christmas Alive event on Sunday at the Denham Springs Train Station Park.&nbsp;Guests were invited to enjoy an evening of holiday magic, including a live nativity, crafts and an animal petting area.&nbsp;Attendees also decided the winners of the Livingston Parish SADD's annual Elementary Christmas Art Contest.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: St. Amant firefighters save home following car fire
item.description: ST. AMANT - Firefighters in Ascension Parish saved a home from being destroyed after a nearby vehicle caught fire Sunday morning.&nbsp;St. Amant Fire Chief James LeBlanc said firefighters were called to a car fire along Acy Road around 7:45 a.m.&nbsp;LeBlanc said the car owner turned on the car and left it to warm up when it caught fire.&nbsp;The flames spread to the mobile home, but St. Amant firefighters responded quickly enough to save the home.&nbsp;No injuries were reported.&nbsp;Permalink|
